entries.title: Isaiah 31:1
segments: God deals with his covenant people in such a manner as to manifest at once the vanity of all earthly resources, and his own omnipotent power and immutable faithfulness.  When he has withdrawn their confidence from every arm of flesh, he sends them salvation from his own presence.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:4
segments: So shall the Lord of hosts come down; having declared the vanity of all reliance on human aid, God now promises to defend Jerusalem by his own almighty power.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:5
segments: As birds flying;hovering over and protecting their young in the nest.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:8
segments: Not of a mighty man--not of a mean man; by the immediate stroke of God.
From the sword; before Jehovah's wrath, represented as a destroying sword.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:9
segments:
To his strong-hold; to his own city, Nineveh. 
 
  The ensign; Jehovah's ensign, the symbol of his presence.  Compare
